description: Audit how numbers are displayed. Pass `numbers` (the strings exactly as shown, as a list or newline or comma-separated text; JSON numbers lose their formatting so strings are better), `context` (axis, tooltip, table cell, headline), and optionally `locale` (en-US, de-DE, fr-FR and so on), `raw` (the unrounded values in the same order, to test whether rounding creates ties or reverses the ranking) and `total` (a stated total to compare with the displayed parts). Checks: consistent decimal places, mixed thousands or decimal separators, the ambiguity of a lone separator before three digits (1,000 versus 1.000), missing grouping on long numbers, mixed k, M, B suffixes and the lowercase m trap, mixed or repeated units and currency, negative-number styles, right-alignment and tabular figures for table cells, uneven axis ticks, false precision, and rounding that changes ranking or breaks a sum. Returns findings and, where the set is uniform enough, a suggested reformatting. Pure computation.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale such as en-US or de-DE.

raw.description: Unrounded values in the same order as `numbers`.

total.description: Stated total of the displayed parts.
